Knowledge facts: part C holds 31 fact blocks (sec11-F01 onward) from physical pages 75 to 78; part C2 holds 13 confusable and continuation blocks (sec11-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer (physical page 3), the DMV 700 March 2024 edition (physical page 1) and the test format from the Testing page (physical page 12); question count, passing standard and time limit are not printed and stay unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NV-INSR-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-INSR-A-PASS — passing score or percentage not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-INSR-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-INSR-A-FRESH — confirm the March 2024 edition is still current (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-INSR-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NV-INSR-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: coverage minimums, lapse fines, the SR-1 threshold and the point schedule are statutory and can change (for example sec11-F03, sec11-F30); confirm them on the DMV website.
